summary: EQT Private Equity Co LLC filed an 8-K to disclose its transactional net asset value per share as of March 31, 2026, determined by its manager EQT Partners Inc. The filing states NAV/share for multiple share classes (e.g., Class I $28.93, Class H $29.99) and provides a breakdown of NAV components ($809M total, 28.1M shares outstanding). This is a routine periodic NAV disclosure for a closed-end fund or interval fund, not a special-situation event. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or management change is announced.
